title: Embedding quality drift detection and offline batch evaluation pipeline
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build an offline, repeatable evaluation pipeline that measures embedding accuracy, ranking quality, and distributional drift across production and training model variants. The pipeline should: (1) produce reproducible batch metrics (recall@k, MRR, NDCG, MAP) on labeled holdouts and reference corpora; (2) compute distributional and calibration statistics (cosine similarity distributions, KS test, PSI, median cosine shift); (3) run synthetic perturbation experiments to estimate sensitivity to prompt changes and tokenization; (4) integrate with the reranking endpoint evaluation flow so that reranker+embedding combos can be scored end-to-end; and (5) emit alerts and drift summaries to Grafana/Alertmanager and a long-term dataset for trend analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Batch evaluation job that runs weekly over production-sampled queries and a curated reference corpus
Computed metrics: recall@1/5/10, MRR, NDCG@10, MAP, mean cosine similarity, PSI and KS p-values are produced and stored
Synthetic perturbation harness that generates paraphrases/noise and reports sensitivity deltas
ANN-backed scoring path (Faiss/HNSW) for large-scale holdout evaluation to mimic real retrieval latency
Integration test that scores at least three model variants and outputs a ranked comparison report
Drift detector that raises an alert when PSI > 0.12 or median cosine shift > 0.04 for the last 7 days
tasks: Design evaluation data schema and storage location (S3 prefix)
Implement batch scoring service using existing rerank binary as a library
Add Faiss-based approximate scoring mode to the batch runner
Implement statistical tests (KS, PSI) and pairwise model comparisons
Create paraphrase/noise generator module and plug into batch harness
Wire metrics to Grafana dashboard and Alertmanager rules
Write end-to-end CI test and publish developer docs
